time.desc: The company's special committee announced the final investigation results, confirming that no management fraud or misconduct was found, and a compliance plan has been submitted to restore listing status.
The exchange officially approved the application for delaying the submission of financial reports, allowing an extension to submit annual and quarterly reports before October 1 to maintain listing.
The company was officially removed from the major market index because its market capitalization fell below the inclusion criteria
The founder of a well-known short-selling agency announced the dissolution of the agency, saying that the phased tasks have been completed
The company confirmed that it will submit a delayed annual report before the cutoff, directly mitigating the risk of forced delisting.
The company formally submitted its overdue annual report and quarterly report, and the exchange confirmed that it had re-complied with the listing application requirements and closed the case.
The company disclosed that there were major deficiencies in the internal control over financial reporting and failed to operate effectively, and it has initiated corrective measures.
The company's co-founder and CEO was arrested and faces multiple federal criminal charges for allegedly smuggling high-end chips to certain countries, bypassing export controls.
The company's directors resigned and an acting chief compliance officer was appointed to separate the compliance function from financial responsibilities.
The company's independent directors launched an independent investigation to verify employees' suspected smuggling of chips to specific countries.

The company announced the appointment of a lead independent director to lead the internal investigation, the chairman of the audit committee to assist in the advancement, and the hiring of independent consultants to cooperate with the audit agency
The company's decision to be removed from the main market index officially takes effect and the constituent stocks are replaced
The company's CEO gave out high forward revenue forecasts for the first time and also lowered the current year's revenue guidance.

The company submitted a supplementary financial report and disclosed that revenue doubled but gross profit margin dropped significantly, confirming that there is no need to restate and completing the compliance case.
Company executives were revealed to have accurately reduced their holdings to cash out before and after the stock price changed, raising questions about insider trading.
Company A announced that it received a letter from the exchange and was allowed to extend the period to meet the listing requirements to a specified date, temporarily avoiding the risk of delisting.
Company A files a Form C document indicating that its shares will continue to trade on the exchange under the supervision of a new external auditor
An analyst firm raised its price target to 60 Currency A after Company A filed for an extension.
After the news that Company A was removed from the major market index was announced, the stock price fell by approximately 8% that day.

Company A's special committee recommended the replacement of its chief financial officer during its investigation, and the company stated that the current chief financial officer will remain in office until a replacement is found.

The CEO of Company A predicted for the first time that revenue in fiscal year 2026 will reach 40 billion currency A, and at the same time lowered the revenue forecast for fiscal year 2025 to 23.5 billion to 25 billion currency A
After Company A updated its listing plan, its stock price soared by about 12% in early trading.
After Company A submitted its overdue annual and quarterly reports before the cutoff, its stock price soared more than 24% in after-hours trading.

Company A's supplementary financial report disclosed that the net profit of the last fiscal year increased by approximately 80% year-on-year, and the revenue increased by approximately 110%, but the gross profit margin fell from 18% to approximately 13.8%.
After Company A submitted its overdue financial report and regained compliance, its stock price soared by more than 23% in after-hours trading, exceeding 56 yuan per share.

Company A's supplementary financial report shows that sales in the previous fiscal year doubled to approximately 14.99 billion currency A, and it expects revenue in the next fiscal year to reach 23.5 billion to 25 billion currency A
